content:
Renee: Heads-up — Dockside private deploy tonight 02:00-03:30 PT. Need smoke owners and rollback gate. tagging @eng-oncall. Who's available?

Kai: I'm on for smoke/monitoring. I'll take app-level checks and can run the canary route.

Ivy: Running preflight now, will post checklist. Backup snapshot started: snapshot-20260415-21:10 (s3://redwood-prod-backups/dockside). ETA ~30m.

Michael: I'll own DB migration and rollback readiness. Migration is online-safe, but I have `rollback_plan.sql` staged. Steps I'll run if needed:

```
# run on standby replica
pg_restore -d dockside_restore backup_file
# promote and cutover if restore needed
```

I'll push the script to ops-runbook and link it.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket #DCK-492 updated — CI: green, infra checks: passed (3/3). Window flag set for 02:05 PT.

Kai: For smoke tests I'll run:
- quick load (wrk 30s) against /health and /v1/generate
- endpoint sampling via curl + compare to baseline
- latency/ER dashboards open (grafana link in runbook)

Ivy: Preflight checklist (posting so it's visible):
- [x] snapshot created and verified
- [x] canary AMI baked
- [ ] DB migration flagged in runbook (will update)
- [x] firewall / VPC peering checks done
- [x] KMS keys accessible for customer env

Renee: Michael, confirm rollback time estimate and whether we need a full DB restore window (approx)?

Michael: Restore estimate ~40-50m if full restore. Migration reversal via feature-flag + quick schema rollback ~10-15m. I'll mark the worst-case path in the runbook and include times.

Kai: Plan for traffic: route 10% to canary for first 10m, monitor errors. If error-rate >1% or latency regression >150ms, start rollback.

Ivy: Note: add `./smoke.sh` to runbook with exact checks (it calls wrk + curl + a few validation queries). Also ensure `redwood-monitoring` group is notified.

Renee: OK plan summary: Start 02:05 PT, canary 02:05-02:15, full cut at ~02:20 if green, rollback decision point 02:40. Notify @eng-oncall and customer success when we begin and after smoke. Everyone confirm :thumbsup:?

Kai: :thumbsup: I'll be on pager and have dashboards up.

Michael: +1. I'll be standing by for DB ops and have the rollback script ready.

Ivy: :thumbsup: Updating runbook now and will paste the links.

deploy-bot: Reminder: runbook link https://git.redwood/ops/dockside-runbook, CI artifacts archived at https://ci.redwood/artifacts/DCK-492. After deploy, run `./smoke.sh` from the runbook and post the summary here.

Renee: Thanks — we'll post "deploy starting" ping 15m prior. Standby.
